user.title: Add a plant
user.description: Everything here is optional except the name — you can add the button and sensors later.

data_description.button_entity: A button, switch or helper. Pressing it logs care against this plant.
data_description.water_event: For an event entity this is the event type, for a switch it is the state. Common alternatives such as turn_on and on_press are matched automatically.
data_description.water_interval: Days before watering counts as overdue. Adjustable afterwards from the plant's Watering interval entity.
data_description.fertilize_interval: Days before fertilizing counts as overdue.

abort.already_configured: A plant with that name is already set up.

init.title: Plant settings
init.description: Care intervals are changed on the plant's own interval entities, not here.
